column1: # Registry of the text the shipped figures render. Produced by the enumerator in
# Columns: sha1(whitespace-normalized string) <TAB> generator path <TAB> status
# status is EXERCISED:<test node id> | REGISTERED:<reason>; UNREVIEWED is capped at zero here,
# because every figure string was composed by this project and is read before it ships.
# REGISTERED means the string was read and judged by a person; the note says what it was checked
# against. A string with a {} field is an f-string template: the field's value comes from data at
# run time and the ruling covers the fixed text around it.
